info.name: WareStock AI API
info.description:
AI-powered inventory management SaaS for warehouse and distributor operations.

## Authentication
All endpoints use httponly cookies for token storage.

### Auth Flow
0. `POST /platform/seed` — Seed superadmin (one-time, no auth)
1. `POST /auth/register` — Warehouse admin signup (creates org + admin)
2. `POST /auth/login` — Login for all user types
3. `POST /auth/refresh` — Rotate refresh token from cookie
4. `GET /auth/me` — Get current user profile
5. `POST /auth/logout` — Clear auth cookies

### Route Groups

**Platform routes** (`/platform/*`) — Superadmin only:
- `POST /platform/seed` — Seed superadmin (one-time, no auth required)
- Manage system_admin and helpdesk users
- List/view all organisations

**Tenant routes** (`/organisations/me/*`, `/users/*`) — Warehouse admin/staff:
- Manage own organisation and warehouses
- Invite and manage warehouse_staff

**Catalogue & scanning** (`/skus/*`, `/stock/scan*`):
- SKU CRUD with per-org unique `barcode` (409 on duplicate)
- `GET /skus/barcode/{barcode}` — resolve a scanned code to a SKU
- `POST /stock/scan-in|scan-out|scan-count` — barcode stock movements (warehouse_admin/staff)
- `POST /stock/scan/image` — AI barcode decode from a mobile-camera photo (multipart)

**AI / RAG** (`/ai/rag/*`) — org_admin/warehouse_admin/warehouse_staff:
- `POST /ai/rag/index` — (re)build vector embeddings for the org
- `GET /ai/rag/search?q=` — semantic similarity search
- `POST /ai/rag/query` — grounded natural-language Q&A (Gemini when configured, otherwise retrieval-only)

### Roles
| Role | Scope | Can Do |
|------|-------|--------|
| superadmin | Platform | Manage system_admin, helpdesk, view all orgs |
| system_admin | Platform | View all orgs (read-only) |
| helpdesk | Platform | Read-only support access |
| warehouse_admin | Organisation | Manage org, warehouses, invite staff |
| warehouse_staff | Organisation | View stock, scan in/out |

request.description:
Warehouse admin signup — creates admin user + organisation.

**Required:** email, password, organisation_name, organisation_slug
**Creates:** warehouse_admin user linked to new org
**Cookies:** access_token, refresh_token

Login for all user types (platform + tenant).
**Cookies:** access_token (15min), refresh_token (7 days)
Refresh access token from httponly cookie. No body required.
Get current user profile (role-specific).
Clear all auth cookies.

item.name: SKUs (Tenant)
item.description: SKU catalogue with per-organisation unique barcodes. **Requires:** warehouse_admin for create/update/delete; warehouse_staff can list/lookup.

request.description:
Create a SKU in your organisation. `barcode` is optional (1-64 chars) and unique per org — 409 if already taken. Embedding is refreshed best-effort.
**Requires:** warehouse_admin or org_admin
List SKUs in own organisation. Supports `barcode`, `category`, `name` filters.
Resolve a barcode to a SKU. **404** if not found or belongs to another organisation. Scoped server-side to the caller's org.

Update SKU fields including `barcode` (409 if taken by another SKU in the org). Embedding refreshed on barcode change.
**Requires:** warehouse_admin or org_admin

item.name: Stock Scan (Tenant)
item.description: Barcode scan endpoints. **Roles:** warehouse_admin, warehouse_staff only (org_admin is denied). Location and warehouse must belong to the caller's org.

request.description:
Record stock arrival via barcode — creates an `in` movement and increments the stock level. `quantity` must be > 0. `idempotency_key` makes retries safe.
**201** with movement + `quantity_after`. **404** unknown/cross-org barcode.
**Requires:** warehouse_admin or warehouse_staff

Record stock departure via barcode — creates an `out` movement and decrements the stock level. `quantity` must be > 0.
**201** with movement + `quantity_after`. **422** if insufficient stock.
**Requires:** warehouse_admin or warehouse_staff

Record a physical count via barcode. Stores `system_quantity`, `counted_quantity`, and `delta`. Set `apply_correction: true` to also write a corrective in/out movement (warehouse_admin only).
**201** with count + `correction_applied`.
**Requires:** warehouse_admin or warehouse_staff

Decode a barcode from a mobile-camera photo (AI vision) and match it to a SKU. `mode=lookup` only returns the decoded barcode + SKU; other modes also perform the scan.
**201** with `barcode`, `decode_source`, matched SKU, nested `scan`/`count` payload, plus `image_url` + `image_public_id` (Cloudinary CDN link to the Pillow-optimised photo; null when `CLOUDINARY_*` is unset). Resizing/compression is done locally with Pillow — no Cloudinary URL transformations.
**400** invalid image, **422** no barcode found, **503** AI unavailable.
**Requires:** warehouse_admin or warehouse_staff

item.name: AI / RAG (Tenant)
item.description:
Vector index, semantic search, and grounded Q&A. Embeddings use Gemini when `GEMINI_API_KEY` is set, otherwise a deterministic local model (`local-hash-v2`).
**Roles:** org_admin, warehouse_admin, warehouse_staff

request.description: (Re)build vector embeddings for every SKU in the caller's organisation. Idempotent — safe to re-run. Returns `indexed` count and active `model` name.
Vector similarity search over the caller's SKU catalogue. Org-scoped server-side — never returns other tenants' data. Scores are cosine similarity (with a lexical gate on the local model).

Retrieve org-scoped context, then answer. `generated: true` when Gemini produced the answer; otherwise the answer is assembled from retrieved passages (offline fallback). Returns `sources` with scores for grounding.
